4716-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4716-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1829-4279-4976--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-4279-4976--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3099-3360-3755.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3360-3755.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

971-2757-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least three charge counters on it.
971-2757-4687.description:
Activate a basic Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic Forest or Island.
Activate the Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

2178-2527-3143-4247.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2178-2527-3143-4247.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1651-2709-5143-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Mechanics to become an artifact using Transmogrifying Licid.
Activate Orcish Mechanics by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Mechanics.
Repeat from step 2.

121-553-2093.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Hypersonic Dragon.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

129-1409-1753-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2104-5900-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Lilysplash Mentor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-5070-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-5070-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

847-1459-1636-2719.description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters, Intruder Alarm and Galadriel trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Intruder Alarm and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
847-1459-1636-2719.notes: Once you have extra mana, you can choose the other modes of Galadriel. You can also blink other creatures using Gilraen.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-5147-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
978-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7511.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
5147-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

206-1563-2457-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

650-891-997.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

907-1558-3875-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-3875-4231-6753.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2440-5115-5685.description:
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Eldrazi and Spawn you control.
If needed, activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it. Then, activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2440-5115-5685.notes: You should only perform step 3 if you have no {G} available. The initial mana cost can be reduced if you control additional Eldrazi and/or Spawns.

1479-3756-7201.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3756-7201.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3967-4681-5170-6559.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4050-4681-5170-6559.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1682-2366-5702-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2366-5702-6968.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3661-4053-5315-6989.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

141-413-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

1718-2744-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-2744-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5223-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

222-527-1115-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1115-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

856-1808-3967-4231.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4894-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Breaching Hippocamp.
4894-5470.description:
Create a token copy of Breaching Hippocamp.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Breaching Hippocamp copy.
When the Breaching Hippocamp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3940-6203.manaNeeded: {3}{R} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Red"
1170-3940-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast red monocolored spells.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Displacer Kitten and Haze of Rage's storm ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Red" as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn for each Haze of Rage, and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

2908-3487-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Dream Stalker
2908-3487-5674.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it and Aetherstorm Roc trigger.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1849-3259-3263-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
1849-3259-3263-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-3263-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1064-2335-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Born to Drive attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
1064-2335-4702.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

579-2645-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five mana-producing lands.
579-2645-4657.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {10}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

109-232-1235-4863.description:
Cast Twinflame with Strive by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Twinflame.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask.
Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield triggers.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to hand.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
